limitations_and_boundaries: The model's adaptivity supports learning resolution-independent dynamics and can scale to more complex state spaces at test time, but the extent of scaling is not quantified.
The comparison to ground truth for remeshing requires interpolation to the ground truth mesh, incurring a small interpolation penalty.
The model is not very sensitive to many hyperparameter choices, but the two key parameters (message passing steps and history size) were identified as influential.
The method is demonstrated on a set of specific physical systems; generalization to other domains is not tested.
The model's efficiency advantage is measured on a single GPU; performance on other hardware is not detailed in the main text.

experiments_or_tasks: Assess computational efficiency by measuring inference time per step versus ground truth solvers.
Compare against GCN, CNN (UNet), and GNS baselines.

Evaluate prediction accuracy via rollout RMSE on multiple datasets.

Train MeshGraphNets on mesh-based simulations of aerodynamics, structural mechanics, and cloth.

methods.name: MeshGraphNets
methods.protocol_description: Encodes simulation state into a graph; performs message passing in mesh-space to approximate differential operators and in world-space for external dynamics. Uses relative encoding on graphs. Trained to predict dynamics from current state. Adaptive remeshing via learned sizing field and local remesher. Key hyperparameters: 15 message passing steps, history size h=1 for cloth (to estimate velocity), h=0 otherwise.

methods.name: GCN baseline
methods.protocol_description: Graph convolutional network applied to mesh graphs.

methods.name: GCN (MLP) baseline
methods.protocol_description: Graph convolutional network with MLP layers.

methods.name: UNet-128 baseline
methods.protocol_description: CNN-based UNet architecture from Thürey et al., applied on 128x128 grid interpolated from Eulerian domains.

methods.name: GNS baseline
methods.protocol_description: Graph Network Simulator with history sizes 1 and 5, and variant with mesh-space positions (GNS+mesh-pos).
